name: 14032 · Clarence Ctr, NY
findings: ZIP 14032 (Clarence Ctr) has 28 nonprofit organizations. 13 of them (46%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 9 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (31% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 14032 (Clarence Ctr) has about as many organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: Fewer organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, fewer organizations in ZIP 14032 (Clarence Ctr) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 58% of the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 15 organizations here; 25% of all organizations here have no identified type.
